withdrawn_images.why: DEFECTIVE — must not run. Deterministic pre-init watchdog defect: with flags.bit1 = 1 the IDENT frame's kick called XScuWdt_RestartWdt on an instance not yet CfgInitialize'd (BaseAddr 0, IsReady unset), and the driver's assert waits forever — the image hangs after IDENT, before the opening baseline. Found in the owner's compatibility review 2026-09-01 (blocker 1); never run on hardware. Fixed by gating the kick on S.wdt_started, set only after CfgInitialize → SetControlReg → LoadWdt → Start, with init failure fail-closed.

schedule.rule: A,B,B,A across successive seed pairs (Claim B prereg §4): candidates 2k and 2k+1 share pair seed k; pair 0 = A,B; pair 1 = B,A; …
schedule.pair_seed: host/l6_schedule.py:PAIR_SEED_RULE — upper 32 bits of the xorshift64 state after 4 steps from ((master_seed<<32) | master_seed) ^ (((pair+1) * golden) mod 2^64), 0 -> golden; twin required in the image
schedule.seq_index: seq 1 = opening baseline, seq i+2 = candidate index i, seq N+2 = closing baseline

operator.derivation: host/l6_operators.py:operator_data over the phenotype manifest + local_map.json: the 292 addresses in genome bit order, each LUT's genome bits in INIT-index order
operator.mutation_bits_note: FROZEN for L6 (owner 2026-09-01), both arms — an image/calibration CONTRACT, not a draft: random-safe = 4 addresses uniform without replacement over the 292; map-guided = one LUT uniform over the map's six, then 4 of its mapped INIT positions. The operator's compute time is inside the rate's `period`, so a calibration holds only for this value; operator_data_sha256 covers mutation_bits and the S runner refuses calibration reports whose operator_data_sha256 is not this pin. If Claim B changes the value, C1/C2 must be re-run under the new contract; the old rates may not be reused.

audit.scheduled: every 16th seq + first and last candidate (seq 2, N+1) + both baselines (seq 1, N+2) — host/l6_schedule.py:sampled_audit_seqs, requested by AUDITREQ
audit.auto: §3a item 2: every non-SCORED self-report (STOP_LINK2, STOP_LINK3, REFUSED_BY_PL, STOP_ARM, STOP_SETTLE, and a post-staging STOP_AXI — one carrying an app_oracle_record) audited unconditionally by the firmware before its record — a firmware change for the §2 image; the validator requires it now (validators.records.check_audit_policy policy='sampled', classification by content in records.self_report_class)
audit.exempt: REFUSED_BY_GATE, and a STOP_AXI that carries no app_oracle_record (pre-staging: no raw words exist). A STOP_AXI WITH an oracle record is a self-report and is auto-audited like the others (validators.records.self_report_class)

frames.crc_budget: ceil(4 × expected_protocol_frames / 1000), expected from N + the audit schedule + these brackets BEFORE the session (D-s4); any missing AUDIT/REC/TERM is a structural HOLD independently
frames.hb_completeness: exactly 16 HB per SCORED record (baselines included), checked per record by host/l6_checks.py:heartbeat_completeness_findings for C1, C2 and S; fewer or more is a structural HOLD naming the seq

S.n: floor(0.9 × min(rate_C1, rate_C2) × T), rates over steady-state periods only (interior→interior transitions)

sessions.seeds_note: owner 2026-09-01: C1 and C2 share master seed 0x4c364341 (1278624577) so the two calibrations walk the same seed pairs and differ only in the operator; S uses 0x4c36534f (1278628687). S's --duration-s must be exactly 7200 s (a shorter T would shrink both N and the 0.9 T floor). Every L6 (master_seed, index) tuple — hence every pair seed — is EXCLUDED from any future Claim B schedule; the Claim B preregistration must record that exclusion at its freeze. host/l6_runner.py takes the seed from this pin; a --master-seed on the CLI must equal it.

pass_conditions.hb_gap_note: HB frames only (L2's guard); fewer than two HB frames = unchecked = HOLD; any-frame gaps are reported as transport liveness, never as the heartbeat invariant

calibration.note: D-s3: filled by the owner after C1 and C2; the S runner imports rate_A/rate_B ONLY from rate reports whose bytes hash to these pins

rulings_binding.note: each ruling names the session it authorises and the frozen prereg + pinned image it was issued against; the runner refuses any mismatch, so a C1 ruling cannot run C2 or S and no ruling outlives a re-freeze or a rebuild. --provision-ruling is mandatory: without a P3-K ruling the runner never claims the L6 ruling nor opens the port.

principal_binding.note: the D4 boundary record is bound to the invocation, not only to itself (board-phase preflight blocker 3)
